second_order: making the wait for Tool news into a joke
theme_note: These passages turn expected album, song, and streaming news into bait and answers: posters announce or invent news, while replies get caught, expose the date, dismiss the effort, joke back, or call the long wait itself the joke. regrouped_from: reviewed after all slices; kept distinct from returning to ordinary Tool talk because these passages perform or puncture fake news rather than close the canvas episode

regrouped_from: reviewed after all slices; retained as a single-episode theme because this local subreddit swap belongs with neither fake Tool news nor canvas placement
